jsonld_raw.name: (350 G) ORCHIDÉE LUMIÈRE SCENTED CANDLE
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented candle made of vegetable wax.

ORCHIDÉE LUMIÈRE | Orchid flowers exhale a sensual and mysterious fragrance, where facets of black vanilla envelop an elegant floral bouquet and add a final touch of rich warmth.

Notes:
Top notes: citrus cocktail, Italian lemon oil, fruity.
Heart notes: orchid, Egyptian jasmine, lily of the valley, freesia, gardenia.
Base notes: cedar wood, cedar oil, musk, vanilla.
